title: Tie the report to its commit, give findings stable ids, drop stale runs
description: The JSON gains headSha, the commit that was judged, and every finding gains an id hashed from its flag, file, and changed lines. Before posting, the run re-reads the PR head and posts nothing if it moved. The workflow cancels superseded runs. The README no longer implies minAttention: 0 gives every hunk a generative second look. The stale-run guard is in the untested adapters and has not run live.
